method: Current official metropolitan, synodal, and parish directories were used to establish Hong Kong bodies. Search engines and maps were used only to discover first-party sources. No body was inferred from population, clergy visits, or an unofficial listing.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current metropolitan directory names Saint Luke Cathedral in Hong Kong. It is published under the Metropolitanate of Hong Kong.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Chinese Autonomous Orthodox Church under current Moscow Patriarchate oversight
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current parish site and the synodal record name the Parish of the Holy Apostles Peter and Paul in Hong Kong. It is published under the Chinese Autonomous Orthodox Church.
The current official external communities directory was checked and did not name a Hong Kong body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
The current official diocesan and linked diaspora material was checked and did not name a Hong Kong body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
